title: DECISION: GC ingested_at_ms uses local wall clock not peer-supplied time
description: pipeline.rs uses SystemTime::now() for the ingested_at_ms column in the articles table, with an explicit comment forbidding use of the article's Date header or ctx.timestamp (which is peer-supplied). The grace-period logic in gc_candidates.rs uses ingested_at_ms to protect newly-ingested articles from immediate collection. If a peer sends a backdated article (Date: 2001-01-01), using the article timestamp would cause the grace period to have already expired, allowing the GC to collect the article immediately after ingestion.
